Commentary.Commentary: So that's all from us in this series. Credit to all the players in the World XI for agreeing to tour. If anything, this showed that Pakistan is indeed ready to host matches and is safe for playing cricket. Willfully it shall help in regularizing the sport in the nation. Hope you enjoyed our coverage. Till the next time, goodbye and take care!

PAKISTAN SKIPPER, SARFRAZ AHMED thanks the almighty as usual, first up. Praises his lads for the entire effort and then delves into the start given by Rumman Raees and then Fakhar Zaman and eventually, Babar and Shehzad. Credits the fitness trainer for improving their fitness levels which is shown on the field in terms of the run outs affected. Is proud of his young team's batting and bowling. On the future, Sarfraz is of the opinion that proper chances should be given to the players as most of them are very young. Pakistan has a lot of talent and if proper opportunities are given, the country can go a long way in this sport. Thanks the crowd, then the security, the government, the PCB and finally, the curator for preparing excellent pitches throughout the series.
It is now the turn of the home side's players to receive their medals.

World XI skipper, FAF DU PLESSIS reckons that this series was a huge success. Adds that he would love to come here with the World XI unit again. Credits the opposition saying that there's a lot more energy and the way they fielded it showed. Commends their bowlers for bowling the yorkers and slower balls. Their batters did well too he opines. Ends saying that his is an easy dressing room and thanks everybody, including the crowd, for the hospitality.
The World XI players receive their medals now.
BABAR AZAM IS THE MAN OF THE SERIES.

AHMED SHEHZAD IS THE MAN OF THE MATCH. He says that he was trying to play according to the situation and as he failed to score big in the previous matches, today he decided to bat long and his move to stay till the end paid off. He says that he's working hard on his batting and his fitness. He thanks the coaching staff, support staff and the players for supporting him even when he wasn't scoring big. Congratulates the PCB for conducting this series the way they did. Says that even the opposition players are happy with the arrangements for the series. Ends saying cricket wins and the entire country loves the game.

Credit should be given to ICC and PCB for organizing this series. It showed the world that the sport can be played in the country. This has resulted in Sri Lanka agreeing to play a T20I here later in October and the West Indies in November. Stay with us as we bring you the presentation in a while.

So, cricket is back in Pakistan! The home side showed how potent they are in their own backyard. It's not easy to beat them there. But the World XI couldn't be really faulted for faltering as that's a side comprising a number of players from various countries. So it isn't really easy to gel immediately and get favourable results.

Miller played a good knock but not a dangerous one. He was the last thorn in Pakistan's flesh. Once he fell it was curtains for World XI. All in all, it was a complete game for the hosts as they managed to put up runs on the board and the bowlers helped them defend that.

The Pakistan bowlers were on the money for most of the time in the game. Their pacers Hasan Ali, Rumman Raees and Usman Khan struck regularly so as to not let the opposition off the hook. Shadab Khan had another off day as he went wicketless and was carted to all parts by Perera, who threatened to take the game away yet again. But once he fell, the visitors never seemed to trouble the hosts.

What a game for Pakistan! In the end they manage to win it without much ado. The World XI batsmen it seems were hell bent on gifting the game away. As many as three run outs show just that. They were off to a good start as Iqbal and Amla looked fluent at the start. But eventually they lost their way, owing to no useful contributions from the middle order.
A flick shot it will be to end the innings and match as Sammy brings up the 150 for World XI - some sort of respect in an otherwise one-sided contest. PAKISTAN WIN BY 33 RUNS AND TAKE THE SERIES 2-1!

FOUR! Nicely done. Misses the yorker by a fraction and Sammy, who has been searching this all game, finally gets a chance to swing his bat and dumps this over the bowler down to long on for a boundary.
Another yorker, this is brilliant bowling. DS just about manages to keep it out.
A short ball wide outside off again, Sammy slashes hard but gets an edge which does not carry to the keeper again.
Excellent yorker, around leg, dug out back.
A short ball outside off, Sammy looks to cut but gets an outside edge which falls short of Sarfraz.
RUMMAN RAEES to bowl the last over.
This ball is flicked to mid-wicket.
Short ball is pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
This ball is driven straight to mid off.
Bowls a slower ball outside off, Sammy looks to smash it. Gets an edge that lands just short of the diving keeper.

FOUR! What power Sammy has! Ali bowls it short around off and middle, Sammy just bludgeons it wide of long on for a boundary. The ball landed just in front of the ropes and the fielder stood no chance of cutting that off.
Short ball around off, Sammy pulls it to long on. He doesn't take the run in a bid to face the maximum number of balls.
This is bowled on the pads, Badree looks to pull it but gets hit on the pads. The players appeal to no avail.
This ball is driven to long on for a run.
Beaten! Bowls a length ball outside off, Sammy looks to smash that but gets beaten.
SAMUEL BADREE is the next man in.

OUT! Morkel has to depart now, courtesy a direct hit! Khan bowls a length ball around off and middle, Morkel backs away and hits it towards mid off for a quick run. The fielder there, Azam has a shy at the bowler's end to catch Morkel well short of the ground. He departs in a bid to get Sammy on strike!
This short ball has been pulled away through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls it around off, Morkel drives it to long on for a run.
USMAN KHAN is back on for another spell.
MORNE MORKEL walks in next. Does he have it in him to take them home from here?

OUT! Killer Miller has to walk back. Ali bowls a length ball around middle and leg, Miller pulls it but gets it off the toe end. The ball travels only as far as the deep mid-wicket fielder who pouches that safely. End of the last hope, maybe!
This ball is played through mid-wicket for a run.

ALi bowls a length ball around middle and leg, Miller fails to get bat to that. The ball hits his pads and rolls towards point as they take a leg bye. Ahmed has a shy at the bowler's end but the ball hits Miller who is completing the run. Sarfraz appeals to no avail.
Length ball outside off, Miller looks to flay that but wears it on the thighs.
This is a tad short, Sammy pulls it away through mid-wicket for a run.

SIX! Going, going, going and gone finally! Ali bowls a length ball around middle, Sammy gets under that and smashes it straight over. The long on fielder seems interested as the ball is in the air perennially! It lands just over the ropes for a maximum even as the fielder there dives over the rope.
HASAN ALI is back into the attack.
FOUR! Pulled with disdain! Raees bowls a short ball on the body, Miller swivels and pulls it to the left of short fine leg for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, cut away through point for a brace.
Length ball around middle and leg, Sammy gets an inside edge onto his pads as he looks to play that. The ball rolls to the leg side and they take a run.
Bowls it on the pads, Miller misses the flick but misses. They steal a leg bye.
Short ball around middle, pulled away towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Shadab Khan is down! As he looked to field that ball, the ball hit him in the unmentionable part! The physio is out there but there's nothing much that he can do here.
He bowls a length ball around off, Sammy drives it towards covers, where Shadab Khan makes a tumbling stop.
World XI need to get a move on here.
Bowls a length ball in line of the stumps, Sammy drives it through mid on for a run.
Khan hurls a yorker around off, Sammy does well to dig it out.
This ball is pulled away towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, David goes after it but misses. Wide signaled.
Short ball around off, Miller gets back and plays a short arm jab towards mid-wicket for a brace.
Comes round the wicket and bowls a length ball outside off, Sammy plays it in front of point and sets off for a quick run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end, hits but Sammy is safely in.
BAck of a length ball around off, Miller pulls it away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
USMAN KHAN returns into the attack.
The big hitting DARREN SAMMY is the next man in.

OUT! Perera's stay at the crease ends! Raees bowls it on a length around off, Perera looks to pull but miscues it towards covers. Azam gets there and takes a diving catch. The umpires aren't sure whether he has taken that cleanly and hence refer it upstairs, with a soft signal being out. The replays show that Babar had his fingers under the ball and it is indeed a clean catch. Rumman gets a wicket to his name now!
Perera is out caught! But the umpires aren't sure whether the catch is clean. They go upstairs to check the cleanliness of the catch. The soft signal is out.
FOUR! Pummeled! Raees bowls it short around off, Perera stands tall and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a boundary. The just dismissed that from his presence.
Length ball outside off, pushed towards covers for a run.
Slower short ball around off and middle, Thisara mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket for a run.
This delivery around off is punched towards covers off the back foot.
Shortish ball around off, heaved away towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
RUMMAN RAEES is back on.
Another run taken after flicking the ball to the leg side. 24 runs off that over! Very expensive that!
This ball is punched to long on for a run.
FOUR! Bashed! This is a wrong 'un that Perera has picked the bones off! He hits it straight over the bowler and the ball bounces just in front of the ropes.
SIX! A hattrick of biggies! Khan fires this short around middle and leg, Perera goes back and flat bats it straight over the bowler's head. A spectator takes the catch but it doesn't count.
SIX! Another one, this one's bigger! Shadab Khan floats it around middle and leg, Perera uses all his might and slogs it over deep mid-wicket for another maximum.
SIX! Going, going, gone! Khan floats it around middle and leg, Perera takes his front foot out of the way and hits it over mid-wicket for a biggie!
FOUR! Hammered! Full ball around middle and leg, Miller charges down and belts it wide of long on for a boundary. The power in that short was visible!
Full ball follows the batsmen, he flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
This ball is played to square leg for a run.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Miller gets a bottom edge towards the keeper as he looks to play it from the crease.
This one is a slower short ball, which is pulled away through square leg for a single.
Short ball around middle and leg, pulled away through square leg for a run.
HASAN ALI is back on for another spell.
Floats it around middle, driven to long on for a run.
This is punched to long on for a run.

Khan floats it around off, Miller guides it towards third man for a quick run. The fielder there throws the ball to the keeper who whips the bails off and asks the question. The third umpire is referred to. Replays confirm that Perera is well in.
Howzzat? Third umpire is referred to yet again! The appeal is made against Perera. The running has been awry today.
This delivery is played towards mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls it around off, driven to long off for a run.

Howzzat? Miller misses the sweep and gets hit on the pads. It was looped up around middle and leg. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. The replays show that the ball would have spun down the leg.
Worked away to the leg side for a run.
The hero of the previous match, THISARA PERERA is in next.

OUT! Du Plessis' desperate dive fails to save him! Wasim bowls it around off, Faf plays it towards covers and sets off for a quick run. Shadab Khan gets a direct hit at the bowler's end. The players appeal and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that he's well short. That's just poor running!
Is he a goner? There's a direct hit at the bowler's end! Du Plessis dives, but seems to be struggling. The third umpire is referred to.
WIDE! Sprays it down the leg side, Miller misses the flick. Ahmed fails to collect that. The short fine leg fielder stops that. Wide signaled.
Bowls it around middle and leg, worked round the corner.
SIX! Humongous blow that! Wasim floats it around off, Miller charges down and bashes it over long off for a biggie! Good hit!
Tosses this outside off, Miller looks to defend but gets an edge through where a slip would have been.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, du Plessis works it down the ground for a run.
Full around off, swept behind square leg for another single. Good start from Shadab.
A tad shortish now, David goes back and works it through the leg side for one more.
Faf follows suit now. Another sweep, another single.
When in doubt, sweep. That is Miller's mantra. Gets the single.
The quicker one now, Miller  fails to flick and is hit on the pads.
Down the leg side to start, worked through mid on for a single.
Another spinner in the form of SHADAB KHAN comes in to bowl.

DROPPED! Wasim bowls it just outside off, Miller goes back to work it to the off side. Gets a thick edge that Ahmed is unable to hold on to. Tough chance that but you still have to hold on. How costly will that be?
This ball around off is driven to the cover fielder.
DAVID MILLER strides out to the middle. He has to really bat smartly here.

OUT! Wasim strikes! Bailey's scratchy stay at the crease ends! Imad bowls it a tad short around off, Bailey goes back to cut. Ends up getting an inside edge and the ball goes to make contact with the leg stump. He never looked comfortable out there. The World XI are in shatters now!
This is fired on the pads, he flicks it off his pads for a run.
Floats it around off, charged down and played to long on for a run.
Lands it short in line of the stumps, he pulls it away through square leg for a run.
IMAD WASIM back on.
Bowls it outside off, he hits it to the short third man fielder.
This is worked round the corner for a run.
FOUR! Good release shot that! Nawaz loops it around off, du Plessis charges down and hits it over mid off for a boundary. Wonderful use of the feet there.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, driven to long on for a run.
This ball on the pads is flicked away through square leg for a run.
Floats it outside off, Faf looks to cut but misses.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ to roll his arm over.
This ball is blocked from the crease! A maiden over to end the Powerplay!
Three in a row! Bailey looks scratchy at the moment! Raees bowls it outside off, Bailey has a feel for that but misses.
Another ball outside off where Bailey fails to get bat on.
Beaten all ends up! Raees bowls a length ball outside off, Bailey gets beaten as he looks to drive that.
This delivery is flicked to mid-wicket.
Bowls it outside off, driven to covers.
RUMMAN RAEES to have a bowl now.
Bowls it around off, he plays it to the off side for a quick run. The fielder from point has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Length ball just cuts Bailey into two halves as the ball goes between his bat and pad to the keeper.
This ball is punched off the back foot to long on for a run.
GEORGE BAILEY in next. He needs to use all his experience here!

OUT! Oh, no Faf! What have you done! Ali lands it on a length around off and middle, du Plessis works it away towards the mid-wicket and looks to take a quick run but decides against it at the last moment. It is too late as the mid-wicket fielder returns the ball to the bowler who breaks the stump to catch Amla well short. Poor cricket from the South African skipper. Trouble in the World XI paradise.
Skipper FAF DU PLESSIS walks in next. A lot rests on his shoulders at the moment.

OUT! Hasan Ali does his trademark celebration after knocking the stumps over! He bowls a length ball around off, Cutting stays back and looks to heave it away on the on side. Ends up playing it on off the inside edge. The visitors are looking in a spot of bother here and the move to push Ben up the order hasn't really worked.
FOUR! Ali is welcomed into the attack with a boundary! He bowls it on the pads, Cutting just helps it away through fine leg for a boundary. Probably a loosener that!
HASAN ALI to have a bowl now.
This ball is flicked to mid-wicket. 12 runs off that over!

FOUR! And this is the best of the lot! Full ball around off, Amla drives it aerially over mid off for a boundary. The ball landed just in front of the ropes there. Classical shots fetching him runs here!
FOUR! Amla is toying with Khan here! Usman bowls a length ball around middle and leg, Amla moves across and helps it through deep backward square leg for a boundary. Good shot that.
Length ball, flicked a tad aerially to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Gracefully driven! Khan bowls it full around middle and off, Amla times the straight drive to perfection. The mid off fielder dives but is unable to cut that off. The ball races away to the fence.
Length ball around leg, Amla flicks it away towards fine leg for a brace.
Floats it around middle, Amla comes down and plays it to long on for a run.
Lands it outside off, played towards point.
This is driven to long off for a run to get off the mark.
Flatter and quicker in line of the stumps, Cutting blocks that from the crease.
This ball is punched towards long on, past a diving Imad for a run.
FOUR! Beautifully played by Amla! Wasim floats that around middle and leg, Hashim charges down and plays it aerially over mid-wicket for a boundary. That should get him going.
WIDE! Imad fires this down the leg side, Amla lets it go. Ahmed behind fumbles on the take. Wide given.
Surprise, surprise! BEN CUTTING walks in at the fall of the first wicket.

OUT! Knocked him over! Maiden T20I wicket for Usman Khan! Nothing that Tamim could have done there. Khan bowls a length ball around off, Iqbal goes back to play. The ball stays low and goes under the bat and rattles the woodwork behind. Usman is ecstatic and why not! The opener was looking good but is now gone.
This ball is played towards mid-wicket for a quick single. The fielder at mid on had a shy at the bowler's end but missed.
Length ball in line of the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Full ball in line of the stumps, Tamim drives it down the ground. Ali puts in the slide from mid on and keeps them down to one.
Bowls it around off, Iqbal gets to the pitch but mistimes that.
Wonderful start that from Khan! He runs in and bowls it full outside off, Iqbal pushes at that but gets beaten.
USMAN KHAN to bowl from the other end.
Floats it gently around leg, Tamim just paddles it towards short fine leg for a quick run. The throw was fired quickly to the keeper, but Amla was in. 13 off that over!
FOUR! Tamim trashes that! A tad shorter around middle and leg, Iqbal just pulls it through square leg. The ball just rockets away to the fence.
Lands it around leg, Tamim misses his flick and wears it on the pads.
FOUR! This is authoritative! Wasim floats it around middle and leg, Iqbal gets down on a knee and slogs it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

FOUR! Technically a dropped chance! Wasim loops it around middle, Iqbal charges down and lofts it over mid off. Malik runs back from that position, gets some hands on that but is unable to hold on. The ball goes to the fence, just to rub salts on the wounds.
Begins with a flat ball around middle and leg, which is met with a solid front foot defense.
Tamim Iqbal and Hashim Amla are the openers for the visitors. It will be spin straightaway. IMAD WASIM to bowl first up to Tamim. Here we go!

Boom Boom Sahibzaada Mohammad Shahid Khan Afridi and Misbah-ul-Haq travel around the ground in a tuk-tuk, waving to the crowd. The Pakistan team and the umpires give them some time and then step out to the field. Gracious display.
